stories.name: Controlled
stories.description: Controlled switch using parent state with `checked` and `onCheckedChange` props.

stories.name: Uncontrolled
stories.description: Uncontrolled switch managing its own internal state. Initial state can be set with `defaultChecked`.

stories.name: WithLabel
stories.description: Switch accompanied by a text label, recommended for improving accessibility and action comprehension.

stories.name: Boxed
stories.description: Switch integrated inside a box with title, description, and an icon for a richer layout.
